sources_read: .qc-cache/coldwater-strict-2026-10-02-r2/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx (Quality Checks row 25 = check 24; Internal Quality Checks row 25)
.qc-cache/coldwater-strict-2026-10-02-r2/rules/projects/webdev-task-template/tests/ (scoring.toml, test.sh, tools/, all five judge.toml and prompt.md)
evidence: Static review: every file parsed with tomllib and diffed against the frozen template; no RewardKit loader or configured judge run was executed, so this is a structural result, not a run result. All 77 manifest task/rules hashes and the 15 raw-evidence artifact hashes re-computed and match. (1) tests/scoring.toml:1-11 is byte-identical to the template: [gates] render=0.0, constraints=0.0; [weights] functional=0.6, polish=0.2, visual=0.2 (positive, sum 1.0); [floors] functional=0.05 (names a weighted dimension). Each name has its directory in the right suite: tests/gates/{render,constraints}, tests/scored/{functional,polish,visual}; no tests/reward.toml. (2) All five judge.toml [judge] blocks carry judge="claude-code", mode="batched", timeout, isolated=false, prompt_template="prompt.md" (lines 1-6 of each); none contains model, reasoning_effort, temperature or a [judge] weight; timeouts 600/600/9000/900/900 equal the template. (3) Every dimension declares the playwright stdio MCP server (lines 8-12 of each). Only tests/scored/functional/judge.toml declares the second server (lines 14-18): name="verifier", command="/usr/local/bin/python3", args=["/tests/tools/restart_mcp.py", "$APP_RESTART_HELPER"]; tests/test.sh:193 exports APP_RESTART_HELPER after generating and chmod-ing the helper (test.sh:127-192) and before run_suite gates (test.sh:213); restart_mcp.py:9 reads the helper from argv[1] and exposes the single-use restart_app tool (restart_mcp.py:13-22, 29-32). test.sh, restart_mcp.py and score.py are byte-identical to the template. Exactly one criterion calls the tool: cw_save_reload_restart (scored/functional/judge.toml:303-308), matching the single-use design, and functional prompt.md:28-30 points the judge at the tool rather than a shell. (4) Aggregation: gates all_pass, scored weighted_mean. Criteria: render 1 binary, constraints 2 binary, functional 38 binary (weights 1.0 x12, 1.5 x20, 2.0 x6), polish 6 binary, visual 3 likert with points=5 and five described anchors each (visual/judge.toml:25-29, 40-44, 55-59). All 50 ids are unique per file and across files, id equals name, all weights positive, all descriptions non-empty, every criterion has exactly the template key set. (5) Each prompt_template resolves to an existing prompt.md containing {criteria} and {app_context} (functional prompt.md:3,32; others at lines 3 and 7 or 21); tests/app_context.md exists and test.sh:195-201 substitutes it. Counterexample attempts: a mis-suited dimension, a restart server on a non-functional dimension, a non-binary gate criterion, a duplicate id and an unresolved prompt were each looked for and none exists. Limitation: acceptance by the real RewardKit loader is unmeasured (preflight.json itself says its schema check does not replace loader verification); the non-criterion keys are identical to the template, which bounds that risk but does not measure it.
